requirements: Organic concave botanical corner ornament suitable for framing an inner content edge
Transparent background with a clean isolated silhouette
Natural asymmetry and restrained botanical irregularity rather than rigid geometry
Clear contiguous forms that trace cleanly into a reusable SVG mask
Enough negative space to remain legible at mobile scale
No baked material appearance; shape and material must remain separable
High source resolution and clean anti-aliased edges
forbidden: No shadows, glow, bevel, embossing or three-dimensional lighting
No gold, metallic, paper or other material texture
No text, lettering, logos or watermark
No rectangular frame border or complete four-corner frame
No hard diamond-like or mechanically repeated geometry
No assumption that mirroring or rotation preserves the intended natural composition
